title: 第11章 抓山鸡收获满满第12章 一只炖了一只炒了
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第11章抓山鸡，收获满满
“这样就能抓到兔子吗？”
在兔子洞口，江能文吸溜着鼻子，盯着江尘放下的陷阱问。
江尘又在套索前撒了几粒粟米，说：“等着吧，说不定就有兔子钻进去。
只要被套住，就跑不了了。”
他选的竹片很结实，一半都插进了土里，就算是三四斤的兔子，被套住也绝对跑不了。
在之前有兔子脚印的地方分别摆了三个套索后，江尘才起身。
回头看了一眼两个孩子：“捡点柴，没事的话我们就下山。”
“啊？”
江能文有点失望，“二叔，我们还没见到兔子呢！”
“明天我带你们来看陷阱，说不定能看到活着的兔子。”
两个孩子被哄住，终于开始在附近晃荡着捡柴。
直到天色渐晚，江尘喊了一声，三人一同下山。
来的时候，江晓芸和江能文都兴致勃勃；
可打了一下午柴，两人都有些蔫了，无精打采的跟在后面。
江尘走在前面，忽然停住脚步，喊了一句：“咦，山鸡脚印！”
“哪呢哪呢！”
江能文第一个窜过来，果然看到江尘脚边有一对像鸡爪的脚印。
“真的有！”
江能文赶忙四处张望，“二叔，附近会有山鸡吗？”

一说到山鸡，江能文嘴里就不由得流口水。
江晓芸刚要低头细看脚印，却被江尘用脚挡住了：“往这边去了，跟我来！”
说完，他朝着山脚下走去。
江能文和江晓芸拔腿跟上，生怕错过了什么。
不多时，三人到了小黑山脚下，一处隐蔽的山坳中。
踏进山坳，北风立刻熄了，难怪山鸡会躲在这里。
穿过几丛干枯的荆棘，江尘也终于看到了卦签提示的那片灌木。
没意外的话，山鸡应该躲在灌木下面抱团取暖。
江能文跑得气喘吁吁，抬头问：“二叔，这里有山鸡吗？”
“嘘！”
“有毛！”
江晓芸左手捂着嘴，低声惊呼，右手指着前方地上掉落的一根鸡毛。
江能文也连忙捂住嘴，低声喊着：“山鸡！
二叔，这里肯定有山鸡！”
江尘伏低身子，装作观察四周的样子，然后指了指前方：“山鸡怕冷，现在肯定躲在那堆灌木下面。”
“晓芸，你去左边；能文，你去右边。
等我拨开草丛，你们就上手抓！”
两个娃娃捂着嘴，一个劲点头。
“走。”
江尘猫着腰小心靠近，江能文和江晓芸学着他的样子，一点点挪过去。

走到灌木旁时，江能文睁大了眼睛——他透过枝叶，看到了里面山鸡艳丽的羽毛，而且不止一只！
江尘屏住呼吸，双手猛地拨开灌木，随即也顾不得其他，直接扑上去用身体压住。
“啾——！”
山鸡尖叫着扑腾，有东西被压住了；其他的瞬间“炸窝”
content_en:
Chapter 11: Catching pheasants, full of harvest
"Can I catch a rabbit this way?"
At the entrance of the rabbit hole, Jiang Nengwen sniffed and stared at the trap Jiang Chen had laid.
Jiang Chen threw a few more grains of corn in front of the noose and said, "Just wait, maybe a rabbit will get in.
As long as you are trapped, you can't escape. "
The bamboo pieces he chose were very strong, and half of them were inserted into the soil. Even a rabbit weighing three to four pounds would never be able to escape if it was trapped.
Jiang Chen stood up after placing three nooses in the places where there were rabbit footprints.
He looked back at the two children and said, "Gather some firewood. If nothing happens, we'll go down the mountain."
"Huh?"
Jiang Nengwen was a little disappointed, "Second uncle, we haven't seen the rabbit yet!"
"Tomorrow I will take you to see the traps. Maybe you can see live rabbits."
The two children were coaxed and finally began to wander around collecting firewood.
Until it was getting late, Jiang Chen shouted and the three of them went down the mountain together.
When they arrived, Jiang Xiaoyun and Jiang Nengwen were in high spirits;
But after collecting firewood all afternoon, both of them felt a little tired and followed listlessly.
Jiang Chen was walking in front when he suddenly stopped and shouted, "Hey, pheasant footprints!"
"Where is it!"
Jiang Nengwen was the first to rush over, and sure enough he saw a pair of footprints that looked like chicken feet at Jiang Chen's feet.
"It really does!"
Jiang Nengwen quickly looked around, "Second uncle, are there any pheasants nearby?"
When Jiang Nengwen mentioned the pheasant, his mouth watered.
Jiang Xiaoyun was about to lower her head and take a closer look at the footprints, but Jiang Chen blocked her with his foot: "Come this way, follow me!"
After speaking, he walked towards the foot of the mountain.
Jiang Nengwen and Jiang Xiaoyun rushed to follow, for fear of missing something.
Not long after, the three of them arrived at a hidden mountain col at the foot of Xiaohei Mountain.
Stepping into the mountain col, the north wind died down immediately. No wonder the pheasants would hide here.
After passing through several dry thorns, Jiang Chen finally saw the bush indicated by the fortune teller.
If nothing unexpected happens, the pheasants should hide under the bushes and huddle together for warmth.
Jiang Nengwen ran out of breath, raised his head and asked, "Second uncle, are there any pheasants here?"
"Shh!"
"Hairy!"
Jiang Xiaoyun covered her mouth with her left hand, exclaimed in a low voice, and pointed to a chicken feather that fell on the ground in front of her with her right hand.
Jiang Nengwen also quickly covered his mouth and shouted in a low voice: "Pheasant!
Second uncle, there must be pheasants here! "
Jiang Chen lowered his body, pretending to observe the surroundings, and then pointed ahead: "The pheasant is afraid of the cold, and must be hiding under those bushes now."
"Xiaoyun, you go to the left; Nengwen, you go to the right.
Wait for me to clear away the grass, and you can grab it! "
The two dolls covered their mouths and nodded.
"Let's go."
Jiang Chen leaned forward and approached cautiously. Jiang Nengwen and Jiang Xiaoyun imitated his example and moved over little by little.
When he walked to the bush, Jiang Nengwen opened his eyes wide - through the branches and leaves, he saw the gorgeous feathers of the pheasant inside, and there was more than one!
Jiang Chen held his breath and violently pushed aside the bushes with both hands. Then he didn't care about anything else and rushed forward to suppress it with his body.
"Chirp——!"
The pheasant screamed and fluttered, something was suppressed; other moments "exploded the nest"
